name: Gravel Hollow
flavor: Gentle. Mostly. Somebody left a chair on the route.

name: Wren Station
flavor: The station master tips in birdseed.

name: Sump Nine
flavor: It is wet. The cargo will be wet. Manage expectations.

name: Tallow Ridge
flavor: One long grade. Trim early or trim never.

name: Kettle Pass
flavor: Gusts funnel through the pass at exactly the wrong moment.

name: Halfmast
flavor: The flag has been at half mast since the last piano. The hammer is unrelated.

name: Brine Terrace
flavor: Terraced. Gaps between every terrace. Bring planks.

name: Cinder Stair
flavor: Not stairs. Worse. The crusher has no emergency stop.

name: The Shelf
flavor: A shelf, a drop, three fans and somebody's launch ramp.

name: Lantern Reach
flavor: Longest route on the books. Every safety inspector quit.
